name: E-book Reader
description: Read EPUB, PDF, TXT, MOBI, AZW3, DOCX, comics and more in 18 formats, with paged, double-page and scrolling layouts, text-to-speech, translation, highlights and notes. Books and notes are written to a real folder on your disk through a bundled native sidecar.
releaseNotes: 18 book formats, paged/double-page/scrolling layouts, text-to-speech, translation, highlights and notes, real on-disk library via native sidecar, in-app folder picker. v1.2.2: visible previous/next page buttons in every paged layout, working double-page spread, swipe-to-turn on touch screens, and imported PDFs now keep the file name on disk instead of the stale embedded title. v1.2.3: PDFs whose embedded fonts cannot be mapped are detected automatically and re-rendered with system fonts, so Chinese text is readable instead of showing the wrong characters. v1.2.4: paged layouts no longer push the paper off-screen — text now paginates inside a fixed page while the sheet stays put, so single and double page both show complete, readable pages for TXT and every other text format; double page actually splits the screen in two; code and command lines are no longer stretched by justification; the page adds proper inner margins.

zh-CN.name: 电子书阅读器
zh-CN.description: 支持 EPUB、PDF、TXT、MOBI、AZW3、DOCX、漫画等 18 种格式，单页 / 双页 / 滚动三种排版，可听书、翻译、划线与记笔记；通过随包提供的原生后端把书籍与笔记真正写入本机磁盘目录。
